finalText:
All 12 files parse cleanly and now match the `db.execute({ sql, params })` pattern used elsewhere.

One thing I left alone: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still calls `db.query`, but that file is explicitly marked "vendored... replaced wholesale on every upgrade, local changes are silently lost" — editing it wouldn't stick, so it needs to be handled upstream (or `db.query` kept until that vendor dependency drops it) rather than patched locally. Worth flagging to whoever owns that dependency.
